name: Prompt Bar
description: AI chat prompt input with auto-growing textarea, plus-menu for sources, slash commands, model and effort pickers, attachments, dictation, and a send/stop button that morphs shape.
contents: Plus menu listing sources with attach option
Slash command menu opened by typing a command token
Model picker and effort picker menus
Attachment chips, dictation mic button, send/stop morph button
Glow and spark effect that reacts to typing
behavior: Textarea grows up to maxRows then scrolls
Menus open from the plus button, typed tokens, or picker buttons and close on outside pointer down
Send button morphs between arrow and square when busy
Send button squashes and tilts, and the bar scales on press
Spark glow is drawn on a canvas and intensifies with typing energy
editableByProps: Placeholder, sources, slash commands, models and effort levels
Default model and effort, busy state, and all callbacks
Colors, spark color and intensity, width, radius, max rows
Morph duration, squash, tilt and press scale of the send button

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the send and stop icon shapes
Change default sources, commands, models or effort lists
needsCodeEdit.where: DEFAULT_SOURCES, DEFAULT_COMMANDS, DEFAULT_MODELS and DEFAULT_EFFORTS constants

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the line height used for textarea sizing

fixed: Client component, uses a canvas and browser APIs
Adds a document pointerdown listener while mounted to close menus
Uses Tailwind arbitrary-value classes, so Tailwind is required
Bar is a fixed pixel width (default 400), narrower screens need a smaller width prop
Menu labels and UI strings other than the placeholder are hardcoded
